change_summary: First main-process workspace-bar service: entry list, pinned-entry persistence and single-frame switching, with window disappearance tracked through the windows service's destroy event
metric.name: visible_windows_after_close

notes: Classified build_failure: the bundling step failed before any test could run, and what it had assembled was already missing dependency files. The dot-directory glob hazard is now seen twice in this paper - once on the server assembly (vibe::remote-server, trial 2) and once on the client packaging - and both times it fails silently until something reaches for a file that was never copied.
